    hc.cust_last_name,
    hc.cust_email,

    ho.order_total,

  AND l.country_id = 'US'
  AND UPPER(l.city) LIKE UPPER('%SOUTHLAKE%')
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    w.warehouse_name,
    hc.cust_email,
    hc.cust_last_name,
    hc.cust_first_name,
    w.wh_geo_location.SDO_POINT.Y AS GETYCOL,
    ho.order_total,
    0.0,
    0.0,
    ho.order_id,
    ho.order_id
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE ho.order_total > 5000 
  AND l.country_id = 'US'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
    fb.building_name,
    ccso.subject_title,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(40)),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(35)),
    AVG(ccso.duration) OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.academic_year ORDER BY ccso.term_start_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING),
    ccso.duration,
    0.0,
    0.0,

    SELECT DISTINCT
        subject_title,
        term_start_date,
        term_end_date - term_start_date AS duration,
        academic_year,
        meet_place
    FROM academic_terms
    JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cis

) ccso
JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON ccso.meet_place = fr.fclt_room_key
JOIN fclt_building fb ON fb.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key
WHERE ccso.term_start_date = TO_DATE('2017-09-05', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

```sql
SELECT 
    at.term_description, 
    at.is_current_term, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.course_number) AS total_courses, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.isbn) AS total_materials, 
    MIN(tso.num_enrolled_students) AS min_enrolled_students, 
    MAX(tso.num_enrolled_students) AS max_enrolled_students, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.offer_school_name) AS total_num_schools, 
    SUM(td.record_count) AS total_records, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS col9, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS col10, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS DAYNAMECOL, 
    STDDEV(tm.rental_new_price) AS STDDEVCOL, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN tso.course_number_sort LIKE '%15%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COL_ALIAS, 
    CASE WHEN NOT (at.is_current_term LIKE '%N%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FALSECOL, 
    0 AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    NVL(at.is_current_term, at.term_code) AS IFNULLCOL 
FROM academic_terms_all at 
LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered tso 
    ON at.term_code = tso.term_code 
JOIN tip_detail td 
    ON td.tip_subject_offered_key = tso.tip_subject_offered_key 
JOIN tip_material tm 
    ON td.tip_material_key = tm.tip_material_key 
JOIN tip_material_status tms 
    ON td.tip_material_status_key = tms.tip_material_status_key 
WHERE tso.warehouse_load_date = TO_DATE('2024-12-20', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY at.term_code, at.term_description, at.is_current_term 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 
    w.warehouse_name, 
    hc.cust_email, 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ho.order_date) AS YEARCOL, 
    ho.order_total, 
    0, 
    0, 
    0, 
    0.0, 
    hc.cust_first_name, 
    hc.cust_last_name, 
    TRIM(TO_CHAR(ho.order_date, 'DAY')) AS DAYNAMECOL, 
    ho.customer_id AS STDDEVCOL, 
    w.warehouse_id AS COL_ALIAS, 
    hc.account_mgr_id AS FALSECOL, 
    TREAT(SDO_GEOMETRY(hc.cust_geo_location).GET_SDO_POINT() AS SDO_POINT_TYPE).Y AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(40)) AS IFNULLCOL 
FROM h_customers hc 
JOIN h_orders ho 
    ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id 
CROSS JOIN warehouses w 
JOIN locations l 
    ON w.location_id = l.location_id 
WHERE ho.order_total > 5000 
    AND l.country_id = 'US' 
UNION ALL 
SELECT DISTINCT 
    TRIM(TO_CHAR(t1.birthday, 'DAY')) AS DAYNAMECOL, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(35)), 
    t1.id, 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.birthday), 
    0.0, 
    0.0, 
    0.0, 
    0.0, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)), 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)), 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)), 
    0.0, 
    0.0, 
    0.0, 
    0.0, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(40)) 
FROM patient t1 
JOIN laboratory t2 
    ON t1.id = t2.id 
WHERE t1.id IN ( 
    SELECT id 
    FROM laboratory 
    WHERE hct >= 52 
    GROUP BY id
```

    hc.cust_last_name, 
    hc.cust_email, 
    w.warehouse_name,

        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS COL_ALIAS_2

    h_customers hc 
    INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id 
    CROSS JOIN warehouses w 
    INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id

    AND l.country_id = 'US'

    AND hc.cust_first_name LIKE '%Matthias%'

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
    fr.room_full_name,
    b.building_name,
    b.building_street_address,
    fba.city,
    fba.state,
    fba.postal_code,
    fb.building_height,
    (date_trunc('MONTH', course_catalog_subject_offered.last_activity_date) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH - 1 day')::date AS COL_ALIAS,
    course_catalog_subject_offered.total_units::DOUBLE PRECISION AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    TO_DATE(course_catalog_subject_offered.academic_year, 'YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM fr.warehouse_load_date) AS DAYCOL,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fb.warehouse_load_date) AS YEARCOL,
    TO_CHAR(course_catalog_subject_offered.last_activity_date, 'Mon DD, YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    course_catalog_subject_offered.warehouse_load_date AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    (date_trunc('MONTH', b.warehouse_load_date) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH - 1 day')::date AS COL_ALIAS_4,
    course_catalog_subject_offered.warehouse_load_date - INTERVAL '3 days' AS ADDDATE_INTCOL 
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered 
JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON meet_place = fclt_room_key 
JOIN fclt_building_address fba ON fba.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key 
JOIN fclt_building fb ON fb.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key 
JOIN buildings b ON b.building_key = fr.fclt_building_key 
WHERE department_name = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' 
  AND fba.address_purpose = 'STREET' 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 
    w.warehouse_name::VARCHAR(200), 
    hc.cust_email::VARCHAR(200), 
    hc.cust_last_name::VARCHAR(100), 
    hc.cust_first_name::VARCHAR(100), 
    NULL::VARCHAR(100),  -- Aligns with fba.state
    NULL::VARCHAR(100),  -- Aligns with fba.postal_code
    NULL::VARCHAR(100),  -- Aligns with fb.building_height
    NULL::DATE,          -- Aligns with COL_ALIAS
    ST_X(hc.cust_geo_location::geometry)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS GETXCOL, 
    NULL::DATE,          -- Aligns with COL_ALIAS_1
    CAST(ho.order_total AS INTEGER) AS DAYCOL,  -- Match first query's integer type
    hc.customer_id AS YEARCOL, 
    NULL::TEXT,          -- Aligns with COL_ALIAS_2
    (date_trunc('MONTH', ho.order_date) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH - 1 day')::date AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    DATE '2025-05-30' AS COL_ALIAS_1, 
    ho.order_date::DATE AS ADDDATE_INTCOL  -- Cast to match first query's date type
FROM h_customers hc 
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id 
CROSS JOIN warehouses w 
INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id 
WHERE ho.order_total > 5000 
  AND l.country_id = 'US'
```

```sql
WITH subjectcounts AS (
  SELECT 
    term_code,
    fall_instructors,
    subject_id,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY term_code) AS total_subjects,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fall_instructors) AS experience 
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered 
  WHERE term_code = '2023FA'
)
SELECT 
  hc.cust_first_name,
  w.warehouse_name AS nearest_warehouse,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM ho.order_date) AS DAYCOL,
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM ho.order_date) AS DAYOFWEEKCOL,
  ST_X(w.wh_geo_location::geometry) AS GETXCOL,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ho.order_date) AS YEARCOL,
  DATE '2025-05-30',
  TO_CHAR(ho.order_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS COL_ALIAS,
  STRPOS(hc.cust_first_name, 'r') AS INSTRCOL
FROM h_customers hc
```

SELECT 
    h.customer_id,
    SUM(h.order_total) AS total_order_amount,
    0.0 AS col_float,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS col_char,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS col_char2,
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS col_int,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS col_decimal,
    0.0 AS col_float2,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS col_char3,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS col_char4,
    0.0 AS col_float3
FROM h_orders h
INNER JOIN h_customers c ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_name = 'New Jersey'
GROUP BY h.customer_id
HAVING SUM(h.order_total) > 1000
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    h.customer_id AS GETYCOL,
    TRUNCATE(h.customer_id, 0) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    h.customer_id,
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS col_null1,
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS col_null2,
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    FROM_UNIXTIME(h.customer_id) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    SUM(h.order_total) AS total_order_amount,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS RPADCOL,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS LPADCOL,
    AVG(MONTH(STR_TO_DATE('01/04/1986', '%d/%m/%Y')) - MONTH(h.order_date)) AS COL_ALIAS
FROM h_orders h
INNER JOIN h_customers c ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_name = 'New Jersey'
GROUP BY h.customer_id
HAVING SUM(h.order_total) > 1000
UNION ALL

SELECT 
    hc.cust_first_name, 
    hc.cust_last_name, 
    hc.cust_email, 
    w.warehouse_name, 
    ho.order_total, 
    DATE_FORMAT(ho.order_date, '%Y-01-01') AS COL_ALIAS, 
    LPAD(l.postal_code, 32, ' ') AS LPADCOL, 
    IFNULL(NULLIF(LOCATE('a', hc.cust_first_name, LOCATE('a', hc.cust_first_name) + 1), 0), 0) AS INSTR4COL, 
    FORMAT(w.warehouse_id, 2) AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    FORMAT(hc.credit_limit, 2) AS COL_ALIAS_1, 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(ho.order_date) >= 7 THEN MAKEDATE(YEAR(ho.order_date) + 1, 1) 
        ELSE MAKEDATE(YEAR(ho.order_date), 1) 
    END AS COL_ALIAS_2, 
    DAY(STR_TO_DATE('Aug 08, 1966', '%b %d %Y')) - DAY(ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS_3 
FROM h_customers hc 
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id 
CROSS JOIN warehouses w 
INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id 
WHERE ho.order_total > 5000 
    AND l.country_id = 'US' 
    AND ExtractValue(w.warehouse_spec, 'count(/Warehouse/Area)') > 0

    w.warehouse_name,

FROM h_customers hc 
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id 
CROSS JOIN warehouses w

CROSS JOIN match
